posts.title: Delehanty and Fulong take 1st place on Paradox Lake, New York
posts.description: On September 12th, the NYS TBF High School and Junior High Championship took place on beautiful Paradox Lake. The high school division was incredibly close, with all of the teams finishing within just one pound of each other.
